extraction.method: all exact-release .rst/.md documentation sources plus available automodule source docstrings; explicit autosummary, Python/autodoc, C/C++ declarations
extraction.complete_for: explicit supported declarations in scanned files, subject to listed parser gaps
extraction.scope_interpretation: Source-declared candidate symbols; namespace/domain, public status, deprecation and semantic coverage require reconciliation, not inferred parity.
extraction.native_identity: Members/enumerators use lexical native container qualification; unresolved scopes retain source-occurrence identities and explicit gaps. Callback identities use declarator names, never parameter names.
not_extracted: autodoc members generated from imported code and docstrings
implicit/generated APIs without explicit source declarations
prose-only capabilities, deprecations and non-API tooling
extraction.no_stability_filter: Private-named, experimental, extension, example-library, legacy and deprecated declarations are retained; review status is explicit.
extraction.moving_docs_warning: JAX latest includes Unreleased and is not used as the extraction revision; NumPy docs use a minor-version URL. Tagged source is authoritative for this extraction.
